The '''Abyss of Ruh''' was a natural feature located in the [[Rift]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The Abyss of Ruh was a vast and mysterious natural chasm, a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] exuding the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], located deep within the [[Rift]] on the planet Tython. The [[Je'daii Order]] established itself on the planet, exploring such bizarre places and attempting to discover the mysteries of the world. While the Rift itself was a kilometer deep in areas, the Abyss seemed bottomless: attempts to find the bottom proved fruitless. The region was rife with dangers, including volcanoes, quicksand, and acid pits. Deep within the Abyss, exotic and rare beasts and creatures sprang forth that could only be found near the Abyss. Some Je'daii believed the Abyss was connected through underground tunnels carved by the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] to the [[Chasm]] many kilometers away.<ref name="NoP" /> Entering the Abyss opened one to many dangers. The energies it exuded could disrupt mechanical sensors and aviation tech; individuals strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] would be wracked with crippling [[Mind trick/Legends|hallucinations]].<ref name="Force Storm 3">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 3]]</ref>

==History==
Discovered by the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Rian Ruh]], the Abyss was named after him after he went insane after exploring it.<ref name="NoP" /> Je'daii ranged into the Abyss, a forbidden place wrought with dangers and perilous terrain, in groups sent from [[Anil Kesh]] to capture the strange and exotic beasts that appeared in the region for experimentation and analysis. During the [[Great Journey]] of [[Dalien Brock]] under the supervision of [[Je'daii Temple Master]], Brock ran off into the Abyss against orders, and emerged changed and dark. Upon his return to Anil Kesh among the wounded [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s who went into the Abyss to rescue him, he shot and killed Journeyer [[Skott Yun]] and fled into the night.<ref name="Into the Void" />

Following the crash of the [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|''Devourer'']] in [[25,793 BBY]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], a [[Force Hound]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], emerged from the wreckage and fled into the Abyss of Ruh. The surge of [[Death/Legends|deaths]] associated with the crash alerted all Je'daii to the foreign presence on the world, as well as stirring a massive [[Force Storm (Tython)|Force storm]] that would rage across the entire planet. Warned of the crash through a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] sent by Xesh, the Je'daii Journeyers [[Shae Koda]], [[Tasha Ryo]], and [[Sek'nos Rath]] traveled immediately to the Rift to investigate. When the three Journeyers met at the crash site, they searched the wreckage of the alien ship and discovered an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] carrying the stranger from their vision: the Force Hound Xesh.<ref name="Force Storm 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 2]]</ref> Chasing the Force Hound into the Abyss's depths, the three Je'daii experienced hallucinations brought on by the dark energies inside the volcanic and turbulent landscape. Overcoming the effects through teamwork, the trio was able to locate Xesh as he battled a [[saarl]]. Making a final stand, the trio attempted to hold off the beast but were unable to turn on the [[Forcesaber]] Koda had confiscated from Xesh. At the urging of her fellows, Koda relinquished the saber to Xesh, who ultimately killed the worm.<ref name="Force Storm 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]]</ref> Soon after, the Je'daii Master [[Quan-Jang]] arrived, having determined that Xesh was the cause of the storm threatening Tython, and struck him down with lightning so that he could be placed under arrest by Rangers [[Hawk Ryo]] and [[Rori Fenn]]. Quan-Jang, supported telepathically by his fellow Temple Masters, rose into the air over the Abyss and used the Force to end the Force Storm.<ref name="Force Storm 5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]]</ref>
